credits.title: The Gospel of Christmas
credits.overview: A struggling pastor moves his family to a troubled New York neighborhood, where they must save a neglected church from foreclosure before Christmas.

credits.title: Homage
credits.overview: A reformed street figure risks everything when he tries to help an old friend fresh out of prison, only to discover that some debts don't disappear; they come back to collect.

credits.title: Darwin
credits.overview: A group of thieves, that prey on the affluent millennial society, gets more than they bargained for, when they encounter an adversary more formidable than they could've imagined.

credits.title: Single Black Female 3: The Final Chapter
credits.overview: After being wrongfully arrested for murder, Monica has finally been proven innocent. All charges have been dropped and the police have shifted their focus to Simone, who has seeming disappeared. But Simone is bonding with her daughter Joy.

credits.title: Harold and the Purple Crayon
credits.overview: Inside of his book, adventurous Harold can make anything come to life simply by drawing it. After he grows up and draws himself off the book's pages and into the physical world, Harold finds he has a lot to learn about real life.

credits.title: Teen Wolf: The Movie
credits.overview: The wolves are howling once again, as a terrifying ancient evil emerges in Beacon Hills. Scott McCall, no longer a teenager yet still an Alpha, must gather new allies and reunite trusted friends to fight back against this powerful and deadly enemy.

credits.title: Johnny, I Want My Liver Back
credits.overview: A teenage boy's selfish actions awakens a supernatural entity seeking revenge.

credits.title: From Burger It Came
credits.overview: A young man reflects on his childhood memories and fears during the Cold War.
